<parameter name="content"># Claude Code Placement Decisions

1. **Hook** (PostToolUse on Edit/Write): hooks run deterministically every time, whereas CLAUDE.md instructions are advisory and can be skipped.

2. **Skill**: a 10-step procedure reused identically across 14 repos is a packaged, on-demand workflow; distribute it as a shared skill (e.g. via a plugin) so it loads only when drafting release notes.

3. **Repo CLAUDE.md**: a repo-specific convention that should always be in context for everyone working in this repo.

4. **MCP server**: live Salesforce records are an external system, which needs a tool integration with authentication rather than instructions.

5. **Subagent**: reading hundreds of manifests would flood the main context, so delegate to an isolated agent that returns only the summary report.

6. **User-level CLAUDE.md** (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md): a personal preference that applies across all of Dana's projects and should not be imposed on the team repos.

7. **One-off prompt**: schema version changes with every migration, so storing it in a static file would go stale; have Claude read it from the source of truth (migrations dir or DB) when needed, or state it in the prompt for that task.

8. **One-off prompt**: a single-use task for today has no reason to persist anywhere.
</parameter>
